backlot 0.4.36

A film studio for coding agents, in your terminal.

Give one requirement to a producer. The opening discussion settles the design, a director casts actors into their own git worktrees, the stage runs checks and reviews, and the ledger records what happened.

Install Repository

See the studio

The client keeps the cast, the Call Sheet and the Lot in one terminal. Waiting items rise to the top; every role remains an ordinary terminal you can open and type into.

How work moves

The opening discussion continues until the design is final. The cast file initializes the studio and can change later. Talking never moves a task; recorded commands do. Only the person finishes a studio.

What needs you comes forward

A permission prompt that belongs to you is lifted into the Call Sheet. Open it, decide, and the actor goes back to work.

Focus stays narrow

Tab moves through the Call Sheet zones. Only the focused zone expands, so the sheet stays calm while several studios run.

Install

backlot is one static binary. The installer verifies the release archive against its checksums and installs the `hc` core when it is missing.

curl -fsSL https://github.com/followcat/backlot/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh

Prebuilt archives cover Linux (x86_64 and aarch64, static musl) and macOS (arm64 and Intel). Details and manual verification are in docs/install.md.
